learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the behind-the-scenes magic of stage design, lighting, and props that make a theatrical performance truly unforgettable!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Lights do more than just help us see the actors! Bright yellow lights can make a scene feel like a happy sunny day, while dim blue lights can instantly create a spooky or mysterious night time mood.

Props are the objects actors hold or use on stage, like a magical wand, a dusty old book, or a shiny sword. These items help make the story feel real and give the actors something fun to interact with.
What an actor wears tells the audience instantly who they are! A velvet cape might mean they are a royal king or queen, while torn and messy clothes might show they are a tired traveler.

fun_activity.title: 🔦 Shoebox Theater
fun_activity.instructions: Take an empty shoebox and turn it into a mini stage. Cut out small paper characters, place them inside, and use a flashlight in a dark room to see how different light angles change the mood of your scene!

quick_recap: ⭐ Stage lighting sets the mood and helps tell the audience what time of day it is.
⭐ Props and costumes bring characters to life and make the imaginary world of the play feel real.
